facts.fact: La Marina BJ reports that Benin's e-justice project, an information system for managing criminal and civil procedures, was at the stage of a technical feasibility study due to start in October 2024, with a consultancy to be named by September 2024.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice; Agence nationale d'équipement et du patrimoine immobilier

BEN.note: Commissariats are named only as sites to be network-connected; no station record system is stated.
